violated_contract: A server-side path that retires an accepted upload's job handle must leave that handle with a terminal, client-actionable status answer. A handle that only ever 404s, against a client that confirms missing jobs only by a second same-process 404 minutes later, stays 'uploaded' on the phone indefinitely and consumes the shared poll budget that new uploads need.
canonical_prevention: Record every retired handle with its owner and custody state, and answer status polls for it with a terminal status the released client acknowledges (completed with an explicit reason code when bytes are held server-side) after real completion reconciliation declines. The client persists missing-job confirmation across sessions and never orders dead handles ahead of fresh uploads.
